overview: The Commission evaluated intersection safety deficiencies following a member's bicycle crash and planned participation in upcoming fall community festivals. Due to a lack of quorum, no formal votes were taken and several routine items were postponed.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Postponed the approval of previous meeting minutes due to the lack of a quorum.

items.title: Woburn Street Crash and Intersection Markings
items.summary: Reviewed site photos and safety hazards at the intersection of Woburn Street and Shirley Lane following a recent member injury, noting missing stop lines and visibility obstructions.

items.title: Bicycle Network Planning and Traffic Calming
items.summary: Discussed incorporating traffic calming, contraflow lanes, and navigation of private ways into the city's bicycle network master plan.

items.title: Wayfinding and Project Updates
items.summary: Noted the installation of new wayfinding signage and received brief updates on the Clipper Ship Connector project and the Blue Bikes contract status.

items.title: Upcoming Community Events
items.summary: Coordinated volunteer staffing for the Mystic River Celebration and Harvest Your Energy Festival while electing to skip official participation in Tufts Community Day.

items.title: Orange Line Shutdown Convoys
items.summary: Shared information regarding volunteer-led bicycle convoys commuting into Boston during the MBTA Orange Line shutdown.

items.title: Vision Zero Implementation
items.summary: Reviewed the procedural roadmap for Medford to adopt a Vision Zero policy, including the creation of a high-injury network map and a formal task force.

items.title: Infrastructure Improvement Updates
items.summary: Announced that bike lane designs for Winthrop Street, Main Street, and Steve Miller Drive were approved by the Traffic Commission.

items.title: Summer Street Safety Concerns
items.summary: Advocated for permanent traffic calming measures on Summer Street near Barry Park following reports of a vehicle-bicycle crash involving a child.
